input_contract.calibration: Fixed camera intrinsics/extrinsics, nominal 1.5m opening and premeasured vehicle thrust/drag coefficients. No course poses, native heading or actual gate dimensions in navigation.
input_contract.clocks: Public camera/IMU timestamps aligned using lower-envelope packet arrivals; estimated delay, not exposure-ground-truth timing.
input_contract.lifecycle: Fixed 8s allowance after public reset ACK; own six-crossing estimate stops flight. Native GO/validity/finish ignored.

architecture.attitude: Gravity initialization with local yaw zero, public gyro propagation.
architecture.metric_gate: Red aperture edges and IPPE camera pose; hypothesis selection uses image reprojection only.
architecture.motion: Public accelerometer for initial gravity/takeoff; after gate lock, gyro attitude and our motor commands predict thrust/drag. Delayed camera position and velocity corrections learn bounded residual acceleration bias.
architecture.mission: Current/next gate hypotheses, nearer-gate correction, integrated estimated displacement for crossings, bounded image-driven height alignment.
architecture.control: Estimated position/velocity -> attitude/body rates -> gyro PI -> mixer -> four motor commands.
architecture.scoring: Native pose, attitude, geometry, race, motor reports and contacts only reach recorder/postflight scorer.

frozen_protocol.native_data: Recorded for postflight scoring only; all native race values and pose/course traffic are falsified during replay.
frozen_protocol.estimator: Public IMU for gravity/gyro and initial takeoff; after the first confirmed gate, command-model force prediction with gyro attitude, camera position/velocity corrections and online camera-learned acceleration bias.
frozen_protocol.mission: Visually map ordered gates, correct nearer-gate hypotheses, advance only on estimated crossings; bounded visibility alignment and final IMU carry.
acceptance: six native gates and six estimated gates
no collision packets between recorded arm and disarm
all startup/cleanup contact packets retained separately
exact replay with native pose, odometry, course, motor reports, collisions and all native race values falsified
frozen_protocol.final_gate: Native valid completion verifies the finish volume; the simulator may stop pose publication before a mesh-centre crossing. Earlier gates still require geometric crossing records.
frozen_protocol.scope: Native direct arena; official Training/Qualification event selection remains unverified.
frozen_protocol.raw_policy: Temporary trace capped at 384MiB; remove raw data after scoring and replay; retain compact errors and one continuous H264 flight video.
frozen_protocol.prior_results: attempt-15 native-valid 54.8459s with zero contacts; its two unchanged repeats failed at 3/6 and 4/6. attempt-17 command-model native-valid 53.2992s; contact-window audit added before these trials.
frozen_protocol.camera_model_bias: 3-axis bounded acceleration bias learned only from camera velocity innovations

accepted_claim: The public-sensor pilot has completed all six native VQ1 direct-arena gates with a valid finish and no in-flight reset. Repeatability is quantified by all five frozen trials below; contacts and unfinished runs are failures under the stricter acceptance check.
limitations: Not an official Training/Qualification event result.
Known red gates, known nominal size, camera calibration and fixed vehicle model; no general background-only VIO claim.
Local origin and yaw are a chosen gauge. Score uses one fixed yaw/origin alignment and no scale fit.
Position, velocity, attitude and gate depth/progress are estimates, not recovery of every arbitrary native field.
Raw public acceleration is replaced by command-model translation prediction after gate lock.
Capture-to-output age is estimated from public clocks; velocity fits have a delayed effective time.
Full-course contact-free reliability remains incomplete; all failures retained.
next_checkpoint: Make height transitions contact-free on repeated unchanged flights, then reduce waiting/braking and increase speed without weakening the input boundary.

retention.flight_videos: Continuous recorded camera streams with image tracking overlays; no cuts between gates. Scorer counters are postflight overlays.

deliverables.video_frame_count_note: Recorder requested 1282 frames; the H264 stream contains 1281 frames (42.7s). Finish time and success are scored independently from native race records.
